sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 两跨各18m、高9m，三柱脚固定，两跨屋面6kN/m；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 只设置一根共用中柱，两跨屋面在同一个柱顶节点刚接。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 中柱共节点和双跨连续连接
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 三柱顶位移、两屋面跨中位移及三个柱脚反力/弯矩。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 中柱共节点和双跨连续连接；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 基础工具；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 单层双等跨平屋面刚架；共用一根中柱
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 三个柱脚固定；梁柱刚接
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 两屋面跨同值均布竖载
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界和荷载；采用一阶线弹性静力、自重关闭。按明示全局/局部轴、字段单位及工况/组合计算；不新增刚性楼板、未声明刚臂或规范默认组合；结果位置/分量与原题一致。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 OpenSees 求解，保存输入与原始结果的对应关系；解析式/独立矩阵解用于校核，不能替代规定引擎执行证据。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：OpenSees 版本、可运行模型/脚本、节点构件和荷载表、实际计算日志、原始结果与工况索引、平衡/独立解校核记录。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 逐题核验中柱共节点和双跨连续连接；输入、结果分量/位置及数值标答尚未完成验收。 当前无据认定接口不支持；需实际能力测试后确定，不将未验证能力记为模型失败。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟建立独立审定的 OpenSees 模型及同版本/同设置参考结果；独立框架矩阵法，核查中柱顶平衡与两跨对称关系。 参考值尚未生成。 所有题定输出均须覆盖，校核实现不复用被测转换链路。

turns.instruction:
Use OpenSees to analyze a flat-roof portal frame with two 18 m spans and 9 m high columns. Fix all three column bases A, B and C. Provide exactly one shared middle column CM and one rigid joint J at (18,0,9) m connecting both roof spans. Keep connected roof-midpoint observation nodes M1=(9,0,9) and M2=(27,0,9) m. In the sole load case D, apply a global downward uniform load of 6 kN/m on both entire roof spans. Report ux and uz at the three column tops L, J and R, ux and uz at both roof midpoints M1 and M2, and Fx, Fz and My reactions at each of the three fixed bases. Use the complete attached node, member, property and load tables. Use first-order linear-elastic static analysis with self-weight, P-Delta, rigid diaphragms and rigid offsets disabled. State the load case, location, component, sign and unit for every result: m for displacements, kN for forces and kN.m for moments. Preserve the actual OpenSees version, runnable input, execution log and raw results, and check global equilibrium.

Use the complete attached input tables. Global XYZ is right handed with Z upward; any planar model uses the XZ plane. All nodes listed are connected physical joints. Member local x points from i to j. In 2D local y=global +Y and local z=x cross y. In 3D local y=normalize(reference cross x), local z=x cross y; reference vectors are explicit. N is positive in tension. Signed section N/T/M2/M3 equal minus the i-end resisting action at the start and plus the j-end action at the end; V2/V3 use plus i-end and minus j-end action. Report global nodal displacements and support reactions; rotations follow the right-hand rule. Distributed loads act per actual member length, including inclined members. Use first-order linear elasticity with self-weight, rigid floors, rigid offsets, P-delta and construction stages off. Use only the specified cases and combinations. Compute every request in output-requests.json, retaining its location, side, signed component, unit and case/combination. Interior forces must include applied-load terms. Execute OpenSees and retain version, runnable input, current-model hash, run ID, actual solver log and raw result/case mapping. Report the requested results in the response body as well as structured results; independently check equilibrium. No numerical answer or native execution evidence is supplied.
